messages:
ana: Finance ping: two customers saw duplicate billing on streaming requests that triggered a mid-stream toolcall after a reconnect+fallback. Filing FIN-500. Anyone seen this pattern?
diego: yes. Repro trace shows stream truncated -> client reconnects -> router sends to fallback node -> runtime executes toolcall again because no stable tool id. Ledger gets two provisional rows, both committed.
kelly: our toolrunner dedupe is per-instance and relies on client-supplied id. If client doesn't provide id and we switch routes, dedupe is lost.
zach: quick ideas: 1) runtime synth id from prefix hash (sha256 over first K tokens) + tool name; 2) ledger-side short TTL cross-route tombstone keyed by acct+prefix_hash+tool. Both together should be robust.
nana: (typo) ana: +1 to both. The runtime header should be respected by router so it survives rerouting.
diego: implementation notes: do tokenization at runtime (use our tokenizer), cap to first 512 tokens to bound cost. Compute sha256(token-bytes) then base16 encode. Set header X-Canonical-Toolcall.
kelly: normalization detail: for JSON payloads we should canonicalize keys (sort) and strip whitespace before tokenizing so semantically identical calls hash the same.
zach: ledger TTL: 30s tombstone seems reasonable. If a provisional arrives with matching tombstone, mark as duplicate and emit telemetry rather than create a second commit. Emit an adjustment event if we already committed twice.
nana: ops-bot: created FIN-500 and assigned to eng-platform: https://internal/p/FIN-500
billing-bot: <@ana> Ticket FIN-500 created and assigned to eng-platform.
diego: telemetry: add metric billing.toolcall_duplicate_attempts{model,route,reason} where reason in {no_client_id,reroute,lack_of_canonical_id}. Also add a Grafana tile to surface per-model spikes.
kelly: UX: update billing console to display a note when dedupe suppressed a second charge: "We detected duplicate provisional attempts for this request and reconciled billing." Show trace ids for audit.
zach: quick mitigation plan: (a) runtime patch to synthesize header behind ff; (b) ledger tombstone change; (c) alert panel; (d) backfill query to find recent duplicates for finance.
diego: I'll PR the router to preserve X-Canonical-Toolcall across hops. Kelly, can you own ledger change?
kelly: yes, will add tombstone TTL and a suppressed-duplicate audit log.
nana: thanks all, let's canary runtime at 5% then ramp. If anyone wants to repro locally, ping me for a small harness.
billing-bot: FIN-500 updated: assignees=diego,kelly,ana.
